channel.title: Bits & Tickers
channel.description: What got built, and what it's worth. Two hosts, Alex and Maya, on tech, AI and markets, straight from the week's reporting, in three formats: The Brief (the stories that matter in a few minutes, Mondays), The Breakdown (fewer stories, dug into properly, Wednesdays) and The Long Drive (the week at full length, about an hour, Fridays). Every story is linked in the show notes. Nothing in this show is financial advice. Voiced with synthetic voices.
